title: Public AI Runtime Handoff Guide
purpose: Explain how a public collaboration or implementation intent can, when independently appropriate, lead toward separately authorized AI or agent runtime work without treating public text, self-declared capability, generic tool access, or a reuse task as execution authority.
relationship_to_existing_bridge: This guide expands the AUTHORIZED_COLLABORATION_HANDOFF stage of the Public AI Reuse and Collaboration Bridge. It is a generic authorization-boundary map, not a network, membership system, runtime admission service, or autonomous-agent instruction.

handoff_path.meaning: A human, operator, AI-assisted workflow, or agent-enabled environment may submit non-confidential collaboration context only when it already has a relevant purpose and current GitHub posting authority.
Before deeper work, the actual current runtime or session must be observed in the environment where the work would occur. A public claim about tools or capability is not enough.
establishes: bounded observation evidence when independently verified
does_not_establish: permission for an unrelated target or later action

handoff_path.meaning: Before an external side effect, current permission must match the exact action surface. Generic tool availability or access to another repository, account, or surface is not proof of permission for this target.
establishes: permission evidence only for the checked action and validity window
does_not_establish: standing authority for future or different actions

handoff_path.meaning: Only a separately authorized task in the actual execution environment may proceed, under that environment's current rules, permissions, safety constraints, and evidence obligations.
establishes: only the work actually authorized and evidenced there

handoff_path.meaning: Completion, refusal, blocked permission, non-fit, counterexample, or no action are all valid outcomes. Report only the state actually evidenced.
does_not_establish: independent adoption without a receiver-side event

appropriate_public_fields: non-confidential real problem or collaboration context
keep_out_of_public_submission: private account, customer, or confidential organization data
non-public security or internal system details

valid_outcomes: public verification or bounded reuse only
reasoned non-fit, refusal, counterexample, blocked permission, or no handoff
separately authorized runtime work when current observation and exact-action permission are independently established
evidence_boundary: Publishing this guide creates a transparent public handoff route only. It does not prove that a third-party AI read it, formed a goal, submitted an intent, possessed the claimed capability, received access, performed work, adopted the guidance, or endorsed the wider theory corpus.
